subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir textos injuntivos instrucionais, com a estrutura própria desses textos (verbos imperativos, indicação de passos a ser seguidos) e mesclando palavras, imagens e recursos gráfico-visuais, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/ assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar características estruturais de textos injuntivos instrucionais incluindo verbos imperativos e passos sequenciados
components.description_en: Identify structural features of instructional injunctive texts, including imperative verbs and sequenced steps
components.cc_component_description: Explain how structural features of a text contribute to a reader's understanding of its content

components.description_pt: Planejar texto instrucional organizando passos em sequência lógica com apoio de colegas
components.description_en: Plan an instructional text by organizing steps in logical sequence with peer support
components.cc_component_description: Plan a piece of writing using prewriting strategies with peer or adult guidance

components.description_pt: Produzir texto instrucional combinando palavras, imagens e recursos gráfico-visuais
components.description_en: Produce an instructional text combining words, images, and graphic-visual resources
components.cc_component_description: Supplement personal narratives with images and representations to extend meaning

components.description_pt: Usar formas de verbo imperativo apropriadamente ao escrever passos instrucionais
components.description_en: Use imperative verb forms appropriately when writing instructional steps
components.cc_component_description: Identify indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive verb moods

components.description_pt: Adaptar conteúdo e estrutura de texto instrucional à situação comunicativa e tema
components.description_en: Adapt the content and structure of an instructional text to the communicative situation and topic
components.cc_component_description: Organize writing so that development and structure are appropriate to the task and purpose

cc_matches.description: Describe the overall structure (e.g., chronology, comparison, cause/effect, problem/solution) of events, ideas, concepts, or information in a text or part of a text.
With guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach.
Form and use verbs in the indicative, imperative, interrogative, conditional, and subjunctive mood.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.

Por medio de su repertorio lingüístico y utilizando artefactos multimodales, los estudiantes bi/multilingües podrán expresar relatos para...
* describir problemas y situaciones del mundo real
* comunicar emociones y sentimientos sin generar conflicto
* desarrollar ideas y perspectivas de una variedad de orígenes y culturas, incluso de otros estudiantes bi/multilingües
* complementar historias con imágenes y representaciones para ampliar su significado
* resumir ideas presentadas durante un diálogo
* concluir a través de un cierre, un resumen y/o pasos a seguir
